mapper.update: INSERT INTO commendation (merge_key, date_of_commendation, title, target, category, government_departments, note) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfCommendation}::date, #{title}, #{target}, #{category}, #{governmentDepartments}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_commendation (company_id, commendation_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, e.commendation_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN commendation e ON e.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, commendation_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_commendation.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_commendation.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_commendation cc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cc.deleted = false AND cc.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )

UPDATE company_commendation cc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cc.deleted = false AND cc.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ) AND cc.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
